description: One match: teams, score, status, events (goals, cards...), venue, referee; where known TV channels by country and, after the match, a highlights video link. Soccer adds timeline: the events normalised (minute, extra_minute, team home/away, kind goal, penalty, own_goal, missed_penalty, yellow, second_yellow, red, substitution or var, player, assist, player_in/player_out, detail: card reason or VAR outcome; minute null = not known; no headers or xG per shot: not in our data) and referee_stats: the referee's season in the league (games, cards and penalties per game, with league_matches_with_referee of league_matches_played). Matches with a page on our website (soccer, basketball, hockey, tennis, volleyball, handball, baseball, American football): summary, ready paragraphs on the match from our data (table places, form, meetings, season), with key_facts before kick-off and what_it_means after the result, summary_as_of when written; only until kick-off and once finished, English only (no lang). Quote them as facts; never add predictions.

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

name: get_match
